#per read visualisation with given genomic location -- dirty IGV

```{r}
loc_read_view <- function(mod_kit_extract_file_path, chr, start, end, min_read_length = 1000, min_phread_qual = 20){
  mod_extract <- fread(cmd = paste0("LC_ALL=C fgrep ", chr, " ", mod_kit_extract_file_path, "| awk '{if ($3 > ", start, " && $3 < ", end, ") print $0 }'"))
  colnames(mod_extract) <- c("read_id", "forward_read_position", "ref_position", "chrom", "mod_strand", "ref_strand", "ref_mod_strand", "fw_soft_clipped_start", "fw_soft_clipped_end", 
                           "read_length", "mod_qual", "mod_code", "base_qual", "ref_kmer", "query_kmer", "canonical_base", "modified_primary_base", "inferred")

  
  
}
chr = "chr17"
start =  43044295-100000
end = 43170245 + 100000
mod_kit_extract_file_path = "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/20240131_Cell_line_ONT/wehi_cs62_sup_extract_reads.tsv"

mod_extract_filtered <- mod_extract %>%
         filter(mod_code == "m", read_length > min_read_length, base_qual > min_phread_qual) %>%
         group_by(read_id) %>%
         mutate(start = min(ref_position),
                read_id = paste0(start, "_", read_id)) %>%
         ungroup() %>%
         arrange(start)


reads <- ggplot(mod_extract_filtered)+
  geom_tile(aes(x = ref_position, y = read_id, fill = mod_qual, color = mod_qual))+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", direction = -1, values = c(0,1),)+
  scale_color_distiller(palette = "Spectral", direction = -1, values = c(0,1))


collapsed <- read_pileup %>%
  dplyr::rename(start_pos = start, end_pos = end) %>%
  filter(start_pos > start, end_pos < end, chrom == chr, mod_type == "m", Nvalid_cov > 10)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start_pos, y = 1, fill = fraction_mod/100, color = fraction_mod/100))+
  geom_tile()+
  theme_void()+
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", direction = -1, values = c(0,1),)+
  scale_color_distiller(palette = "Spectral", direction = -1, values = c(0,1))

ggarrange(reads+
            theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "none"), 
          collapsed+
            theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "none"), nrow = 2, align ="v",
          heights = c(0.9, 0.1))

query <- ucscTableQuery(session, "refGene", genomicRanges(start, end , chr))

trackNames(session)
```

#load coverage

```{r}
unphased_coverage <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/20240131_Cell_line_ONT/general.regions.bed.gz")
colnames(unphased_coverage) <- c("chr", "start", "end", "unphased_cov")
phased_coverage <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/20240131_Cell_line_ONT/phased_w_tag.regions.bed.gz")
colnames(phased_coverage) <- c("chr", "start", "end", "phased_cov")

# the location of aligned file need to be liftOver, as it was aligned to hg37, LR use hg38 as reference
LOH <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/20230417_PDX_HRD/Scott_-_Ovarian_cancer.wdl/ascat/copynumber/134062-2238-T3.70572a98-3415-45a4-976d-7dc066b43f24.copynumber.ascat.tsv") %>%
  dplyr::select(chr = chromosome, start, end, LOH, tumour.total.cn) %>%
  mutate(chr = paste0("chr", chr)) %>%
    mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = c(paste0("chr", seq(1, 22)), "chrX")))


#liftOver
library(rtracklayer)
ch = import.chain("hg19ToHg38.over.chain")
ascat_cn_hg19 <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(LOH, keep.extra.columns = T)
seqlevelsStyle(ascat_cn_hg19) = "UCSC" 
ascat_cn_hg38 <- liftOver(ascat_cn_hg19, ch)
LOH <- as.data.frame(ascat_cn_hg38) %>%
  dplyr::select(chr = seqnames, start, end, LOH, tumour.total.cn ) %>%
  mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = c(paste0("chr", seq(1, 22)), "chrX"))) %>%
  filter( !is.na(chr))

unphased_coverage %>%
  left_join(phased_coverage) %>%
  mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = c(paste0("chr", seq(1, 22)), "chrX"))) %>%
  filter( !is.na(chr)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(unphased = unphased_cov, phased = phased_cov) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("unphased", "phased"), names_to = "type", values_to = "Coverage") %>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_rect(data = LOH, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 60, fill = LOH), alpha = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "purple", `FALSE` = "white", `NA` = "grey"), " ")+
  geom_segment(aes(x = start, xend = end, y = Coverage, yend = Coverage, color = type))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("phased" = "red", "unphased" = "black"))+
  facet_wrap(~chr, scales = "free")+
  ylim(c(0, 60))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("plots/phased_coveraged_loh_overlap.pdf", height =14, width = 12)


lr_estimated_cn <- unphased_coverage %>%
  mutate(estimated_cn = round(unphased_cov/21) * 2) %>%
  mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = c(paste0("chr", seq(1, 22)), "chrX"))) %>%
  filter( !is.na(chr)) 


delly_estiamted_cn <- fread("delly_cnv_tumour.vcf", skip ="#CHROM") %>%
  separate(col = "wehi_cs62_sup_mapped", sep = ":", into = c("GT","CN","CNL","GQ","FT","RDCN","RDSD")) %>%
  mutate(END =as.numeric(gsub(";", "", gsub("END=", "", str_extract(INFO, "END=[0-9]+;")))),
         CN = as.integer(CN),
         chr = `#CHROM`,
         chr = factor(chr, levels = c(paste0("chr", seq(1, 22)), "chrX")))

lr_estimated_cn %>%
  ggplot()+
  #geom_segment(aes(x = start, xend = end, y = estimated_cn+0.05, yend = estimated_cn+0.05, color = "LR (coverage est)"))+
  geom_segment(data = LOH, aes(x = start, xend = end, y = tumour.total.cn+0.08, yend = tumour.total.cn +0.08, color = "SR (ascat)"))+
  geom_segment(data =  delly_estiamted_cn , aes(x = POS, xend = END, y = CN-0.08, yend = CN- 0.08, color = "LR (delly)", alpha = FILTER)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10), limits = c(0,10))+
  facet_wrap(~chr, scales = "free_x")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("LR (coverage est)" = "red", "SR (ascat)" = "black", "LR (delly)" = "blue"), "CN")+
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("LowQual" = 0.5, "PASS"= 1))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())+
  ylab("CN")



ggsave("plots/cn_estimation_lr_v_sr.pdf", height =14, width = 12)

```
